ops.title: consent relay leg stays fail-closed on ssh exit 255; probe routes around only when ssh's exit is carried
ops.body:
Decision (PR #11, synckit, 2026-10-19):

- `consent.ProbeRoutesAround` routes around only on `context.DeadlineExceeded` or an `*hostregistry.SSHError` whose cause is `*daemonkit.ExitError` (`SSHError.Exited`). A probe failure without ssh's exit (refused spawn, plumbing, truncation-only, collect error) is fatal and surfaces its cause. Reason: a resident whose fd table passed OPEN_MAX (10240) got EBADF from `posix_spawn_file_actions_adddup2` on every spawn, and the old "any SSHError = offline" rule turned that into a silent routed `unavailable` (cc-sudo exit 104 "no live approver").
- The relay leg's `routesAround` is timeout-only. Its documented exit-255 failover matched `*exec.ExitError`, which `ExecSSH` has not produced since the daemonkit runner migration (b691942, v0.37.0), so production relay 255 had been fatal. Kept fail-closed on purpose: a 255 cannot tell a refused connection from a session dropped after the peer prompted, so failover could prompt a second human after the first answer was lost. Reviving it is a separate, explicit decision.
- Test fakes for ssh failures must wrap `*daemonkit.ExitError`, never `*exec.ExitError`: the `exec` shape is what let the dead relay check pass tests for months.
